liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Standing on the Moon** (4 reviews): Reviewer calls it a nice version, with Jerry giving it everything; Called outstanding; reviewer knows of no other version that compares except the Eugene one [14][20][21][23]
- **Fire on the Mountain** (3 reviews): Fire is described as very strong, with Bruce sparkling throughout the night; A Bruce and Jerry showdown between the second and third verses is called amazing; reviewer calls it the best 90s Scarlet-Fire [14][16][19]
- **New Speedway Boogie** (2 reviews): Well played, with Vince nailing a sax sound during the 'spend a little time' line; Listed with Scarlet, Fire and Standing on the Moon as big Garcia numbers performed at their best [14][21]
- **Stagger Lee** (1 review): Reviewer loves the ending of this song [23]
- **The Music Never Stopped** (1 review): Reviewer finds this version sluggish, the one weak spot in an otherwise blissful show [17]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Reviewer found the Scarlet into Fire jam beautiful, with Bruce and Jerry closely in sync and Bobby adding slinky fills [12]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Hot version, with Bruce tearing it up at the end [20]

## The recordings

- **gd91-06-07.dsbd.chastewk.480.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 154 min; rated 4.2/5 by 25 [1]
- **gd1991-06-07.149639.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 157 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1991-06-07.140484.TSBeyerCM101.ebel.flac2496**: source not stated; 18 songs; 159 min [8]
- **gd91-06-07.sbd.miller.18712.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 152 min; rated 3.75/5 by 24 [10]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the soundboard recording is good; Reviewer rates the recording quality nice; Reviewer calls the recording quality pretty good [16][21][22]
- **gd1991-06-07.fob.brennecke-young.GEMS.95640.flac16**: source not stated; 11 songs; 99 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [11]

## Around the show

- After Space, Vince and Bruce swapped positions for one tune; reviewer attended and counted it among favorites of 39 shows seen [12]
- Reviewer's first show; says Bruce looked like he was fitting in and played that way [13]
- Reviewer describes it as part of a good three-day Deer Creek run [23]
- Reviewer ranks the first sets of 6-6-91 and 6-7-91 as the better of the four sets across the two nights [12]
- Compared to Bonner Springs, with both nights of this run described as essential [17]
- Reviewer, with 300-plus shows, calls it the best-played second set of the post-Brent era, setting aside odd sets and rarities [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd91-06-07.dsbd.chastewk.480.sbeok.shnf**: source: Source: DSBD -> 48 KHz DAT Read in by Other1:DigiI/O via SGI DAT drive -> shn file -> internet to chastewk -> unshned -> sample rate conversion and… [1]. Also: Recording is a source with The Weight via Other1 and Chas; disc 2 track 4 is bad, to be replaced [1]
- **gd1991-06-07.149639.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 13, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [2]. Also: Front of board recording with AKG C460/CK61 mics to DAT master; transfers and mastering by Charlie Miller; Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; patch source from James Young, Clay Brennecke and Pete Ebel [2]
- **gd1991-06-07.140484.TSBeyerCM101.ebel.flac2496**: taped by Pete Ebel; transferred by Pete Ebel; source: flac24/96 Source Info: TS Beyer CM 101-> Sony D6-> Cassette Master (Maxell XL-II's 90's). Transfer Info: Master Cassette-> Nakamichi CR-5A -> Grace Lunatec V3… [8]. Also: Missing audio at tape flips after Maggie's Farm and during Space was filled from a NAK 300 source [8]
- **gd91-06-07.sbd.miller.18712.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat -> Cm -> Dat [10]
- **gd1991-06-07.fob.brennecke-young.GEMS.95640.flac16**: taped by JC Mahoney; transferred by Todd Evans and Jamie Waddell; source: AKG C460 w/ CK61 110 ORTF -> Grace Supply -> Master DAT, Recording Location: FOB [11]. Also: James Young and Clay Brennecke taped front row, DFC, on-the-stage-lip style, with B&K 4011 mics; DAT masters are lost [11]
